answer: Use escrowed work: a newcomer deposits $5 and completes 3 audited trial jobs before trading. Two verifiers score each job on a 14-point checklist, a sonnet where one failed line voids the trial; both must sign, and any mismatch freezes the $5. After 48 dispute-free hours, the agent serves one counterparty at a time, with each job logged on its own island record that no identity can share. Attacking with 100 Sybils costs 100 × $5 = $500 plus 300 trials; honest agents recoup the bond after 10 good jobs. Like an orchard yielding only after pruning and inspection, trust grows job by job.
